title: Admin - Search Admin Users - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin User & Role Management - Search Admin Users feature on the Y4J platform. This feature allows Super Admins to search administrators by name or email with dynamic filtering, partial match support (minimum 3 characters), case-insensitive matching, and clear functionality to restore the full list. Covers happy path, edge cases, validation, and error handling.

testCases.title: Search bar is visible and accepts text input
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded with admin list visible.
steps: Locate the search bar in the toolbar area
Click on the search input field
expectedResults: Search bar is visible with placeholder text 'Search admins by name or email...'
Search field is clickable and gains focus
Typed text appears in the search field
The field accepts both alphabetic and special characters
testCases.postconditions: Search input contains the typed text

testCases.title: Search by admin name returns matching results
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list contains an admin named 'IvAdmin1'.
steps: Click on the search input field
expectedResults: The admin list filters dynamically as the user types
Only admin cards matching 'IvAdmin1' are displayed
The matching admin card shows the correct name, email, role, and permissions
The 'Showing X admins' count updates to reflect filtered results
testCases.postconditions: Only matching admin cards are visible

testCases.title: Search by email returns matching results
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list contains an admin with email 'aofted@mailto.plus'.
steps: Click on the search input field
expectedResults: The admin list filters to show only the admin with matching email
The matching admin card is displayed with correct details
Non-matching admin cards are hidden
The count updates to show filtered total
testCases.postconditions: Only the admin with matching email is displayed

testCases.title: Results filter dynamically as user types
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Multiple admins exist in the list.
steps: Note the total number of admins displayed
Type 'Iv' in the search bar (2 characters)
expectedResults: At 2 characters ('Iv'), filtering may not yet activate (minimum 3 chars required)
At 3 characters ('IvA'), results begin filtering dynamically
As more characters are typed, results narrow progressively
No page reload occurs — filtering happens in real-time
The admin count updates with each keystroke (after 3 chars)
testCases.postconditions: Results are filtered based on current search text

testCases.title: Partial matches are supported from 3 characters minimum
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin 'IvAdmin1' exists in the list.
steps: Type 'IvA' (3 characters - partial match) in the search bar
Clear and type 'Admin' (partial match of name)
Clear and type 'mailto' (partial match of email domain)
expectedResults: 'IvA' returns all admins whose name or email contains 'IvA'
'Admin' returns all admins with 'Admin' in their name or email
'mailto' returns all admins with 'mailto' in their email
Partial matches work for both name and email fields
Results appear after the 3rd character is typed
testCases.postconditions: Partial match filtering works correctly from 3 characters

testCases.title: Search is case-insensitive
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin 'IvAdmin1' exists in the list.
steps: Type 'ivadmin1' (all lowercase) in the search bar
expectedResults: 'ivadmin1' returns the admin 'IvAdmin1' (case-insensitive match)
'IVADMIN1' returns the same admin 'IvAdmin1'
'IvAdMiN1' returns the same admin 'IvAdmin1'
All three searches produce identical results
Case does not affect search functionality
testCases.postconditions: Search works regardless of case used

testCases.title: Clearing search restores full admin list
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Search has been performed with filtered results showing.
steps: Type a search query that filters results (e.g., 'IvAdmin1')
Clear the search field (select all + delete, or click clear button)
expectedResults: After clearing the search field, the full admin list is restored
All admin cards that were previously visible are shown again
The 'Showing X admins' count returns to the original total
No page reload is required — list restores dynamically
testCases.postconditions: Full admin list is restored after clearing search

testCases.title: No results shows 'No admins found' message
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded.
steps: Type a search query that matches no admins (e.g., 'xyznonexistent123')
expectedResults: No admin cards are displayed
A 'No admins found' message (or similar empty state) is shown
The message is clearly visible and informative
The 'Showing 0 admins' count is displayed
The search field still contains the typed query
testCases.postconditions: Empty state message is displayed for no-match searches

testCases.title: Special characters in search (@) work correctly
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admins with email addresses exist.
steps: Type '@mailto' in the search bar (contains @ special character)
Clear and type '@illubd' in the search bar
expectedResults: '@mailto' returns admins whose email contains '@mailto' (e.g., aofted@mailto.plus)
'@illubd' returns admins whose email contains '@illubd' (e.g., ir0ijsoebq@illubd.com)
The @ character does not break the search functionality
No errors or crashes occur with special characters
Results are accurate based on the special character search
testCases.postconditions: Special characters are handled correctly in search

testCases.title: Search with fewer than 3 characters does not filter
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Full admin list is displayed.
steps: Type 'Iv' (2 characters) in the search bar
expectedResults: With only 2 characters typed, the full admin list remains unchanged
No filtering occurs until the 3rd character is entered
The admin count remains the same as the original total
OR the system shows a hint like 'Type at least 3 characters to search'
testCases.postconditions: List is not filtered with fewer than 3 characters

testCases.title: Search works with email domain partial match
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admins with different email domains exist.
expectedResults: 'mailto.plus' returns all admins with that email domain
'illubd.com' returns all admins with that email domain
Domain-based search correctly filters the list
Results include all admins matching the domain

testCases.title: Search persists after pagination navigation
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Search results span multiple pages (if applicable).
steps: Type a search query that returns multiple results
Observe if the search query is maintained
expectedResults: Search query remains in the search field after pagination
Results on the next page are still filtered by the search query
The search is not cleared by pagination navigation
testCases.postconditions: Search state is maintained during pagination

testCases.title: Search combined with role filter works correctly
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Both Super Admin and Limited-Access Admin exist.
steps: Select a role filter (e.g., 'Super Admin' from the All Roles dropdown)
Then type a search query in the search bar
expectedResults: Results are filtered by both the role filter AND the search query
Only admins matching both criteria are shown
The count reflects the combined filter results
testCases.postconditions: Search and role filter work together correctly

testCases.title: Search with leading/trailing spaces is trimmed
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin 'IvAdmin1' exists.
steps: Type '  IvAdmin1  ' (with leading and trailing spaces) in the search bar
expectedResults: The search trims leading and trailing spaces
Results match 'IvAdmin1' correctly despite the extra spaces
The search does not fail or return no results due to whitespace

testCases.title: Search field can be cleared using backspace/delete
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Search field has text entered.
steps: Use Backspace key to delete characters one by one
Observe the results updating as characters are removed
Continue until the field is empty
expectedResults: Each backspace removes one character from the search field
Results update dynamically as characters are removed
When fewer than 3 characters remain, full list may restore
When field is completely empty, full admin list is restored
testCases.postconditions: Backspace clearing works and list restores

testCases.title: Search with only spaces does not filter results
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Full admin list is displayed.
steps: Type '   ' (only spaces) in the search bar
expectedResults: Spaces-only input does not trigger filtering
Full admin list remains displayed
No error occurs
The system treats spaces-only as empty search

testCases.title: Rapid typing does not cause duplicate or stale results
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded.
steps: Rapidly type 'IvAdmin1' in the search bar (fast typing)
Verify no flickering or stale results appear
expectedResults: Results settle on the correct filtered list after typing completes
No duplicate results or flickering occurs
The final result matches the complete search query
No race conditions cause incorrect results
testCases.postconditions: Rapid typing is handled with debouncing/throttling
